featured.name: intro
featured.title: The intro, told by Rin
featured.text: Seventy seconds on why a hundred floors of people who cannot die are filing complaints about a woman with a sword. Drawn with three.js and Remotion, narrated in Rin's voice. [How it was made](devlog/an-animated-intro.html).

featured.name: campaign-showcase
featured.title: The campaign showcase
featured.text: The tower from the Desk to the rooftop garden in 84 seconds: the sections, the guardians, the deck and the two endings. [The post](devlog/the-whole-tower.html).

play.name: first-fight
play.title: The first fight and the card hand
play.text: The first room teaches the next 99: a slash, a combo, a roll through a swing, and the katana kicked across the room. Then the first card choice.

play.name: ultimate-ink-kick
play.title: Rin's Ultimate: the ink kick
play.text: She kicks the blade, it cuts the room, and the last stroke lands in darkness.

play.name: balance-playthrough
play.title: Start to credits
play.text: A full automated climb in landscape, filmed after the whole-tower balance pass: every section, every guardian, both rooftop choices, the credits. Nearly four minutes.

bosses.name: winter-widow
bosses.title: The Winter Widow
bosses.text: The Clinic's night nurse fights in rounds: circling, feints, a dashing ice lunge, and frost that freezes Rin where she stands.

bosses.name: homura-duel-1
bosses.title: Homura, first duel (floor 30)
bosses.text: The Captain's eight forms on a cyborg with a red blade. She does not die here: the finishing cut is turned aside and she leaves.

bosses.name: homura-duel-2
bosses.title: Homura, second duel (floor 65)
bosses.text: Faster, closer and harder-hitting than the first.

bosses.name: homura-forms
bosses.title: Homura: all eight forms
bosses.text: Falling Mountain, Three Steps, Swallow's Return, Still Water, One Flash, Tempest, Secret Art, Heaven and Earth.

bosses.name: winter-widow-frost
bosses.title: Frost prescription
bosses.text: Ice at range, a step ahead of where Rin is going. Get caught and the cold compress follows.

bosses.name: winter-widow-rounds
bosses.title: Rounds
bosses.text: Between attacks she circles and stops to watch. The opening is after the backflip.

studies.name: kick-facing
studies.title: Keeping Rin facing her kick
studies.text: A fix film: she now holds her facing through the landing.

studies.name: ink-kick-study
studies.title: Ink kick motion study
studies.text: The first pass at the move, before the darkness and the grounded blood.

studies.name: nurse-first-try
studies.title: The nurse we did not keep
studies.text: A zombie nurse model on shared zombie clips. Her arms twisted, so the Winter Widow took the ward instead.

thai.name: showcase-thai
thai.title: Showcase, narrated in Thai
thai.text: The landscape showcase with a Thai voiceover and synced subtitles, voiced with ElevenLabs v4.

thai.title: Developer update in Thai
thai.text: The same film told as a developer update in Pondd's own (cloned) voice, made for the Thai AI Dev community.
